summary: Completed testing of WishWay Sorteos new features: User Pagination and Delete Published/Waiting Sorteos. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend UI testing confirmed both features work correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created 5 temporary test users for pagination testing (cleaned up after tests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features are fully functional: 1) User Pagination works correctly with page/limit parameters, returns total, page, limit, total_pages in response. Pagination controls appear when more than 10 users exist. 2) Delete Sorteo works for published/activo/waiting states. Sorteos with boletos require confirmar_con_compras=true parameter. LIVE sorteos cannot be deleted. The waiting sorteo 'dfsdfsdf' was deleted during testing.

tests: GET /api/admin/usuarios?page=1&limit=10 returns correct structure (usuarios, total, page, limit, total_pages)
Frontend pagination controls appear when more than 10 users
Page info displays correctly (Página X de Y)
DELETE /api/admin/sorteo/{id} works for waiting sorteos without boletos
Frontend shows delete button for published/activo/waiting sorteos
Associated boletos are deleted with the sorteo
